items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: They used Max Kaminsky, heh-heh, and my brother and them, they used to let him go to the bar and get a drink while they played, because he couldn't keep up with them.

ctx.x: No, but I had my little band. When I came to New York, the band stayed up there working. They used Max Kaminsky, heh-heh, and my brother and them, they used to let him go to the bar and get a drink while they played, because he couldn't keep up with them. Heh-heh.
So anyhow, I came to New York, which was the first White band I worked with, really.
